HOW YOUR BROWSER CONNECTS

A SMALL COOKIE.
A WORKING ACCOUNT.

EDGE uses browser cookies to keep your session connected and protect account requests. Here is what that means when you use the platform.

✳THE DETAILS
BEHIND THE GAME.

ON THIS PAGE

Back to home ↗
01 /

Your session cookie

The first-party session cookie connects your browser to its server-side session. It supports signing in, keeping a pending email-code challenge in the same browser and accessing your account. It is marked Secure and HttpOnly on the live site. The configured session lifetime is 120 minutes of inactivity.

Learn about browser cookies ↗
02 /

Request protection

The XSRF-TOKEN cookie supports protection against forged requests. The application also sends a session-specific CSRF token with actions such as verifying a code or requesting a withdrawal. These security mechanisms are part of account operation.

03 /

Other browser storage and services

The public landing pages do not load advertising or analytics scripts. The separate static platform preview may keep fictional activity in local browser storage; that data is not imported into your live wallet. Stripe’s hosted checkout may use its own cookies under its own policy.

04 /

Your browser controls

You can delete cookies or block them through your browser settings. Deleting session cookies signs you out and can interrupt an email-code challenge. Blocking essential cookies can prevent sign-in and account actions.
